findings.title: No test covers null priority input to create_item
findings.description: The create_item function was changed to accept a priority field but there is no test asserting behaviour when priority is None or absent.
findings.evidence: grep for 'priority' in sample-project/tests/ returns no test function.
findings.recommendation: Add a test that POSTs to the create endpoint without a priority field and asserts the response is valid.

findings.title: test_create_ticket_missing_fields fails in snapshot
findings.description: The existing test for missing required fields now fails because the endpoint returns 500 instead of 422 when priority is None.
findings.recommendation: Fix the null handling in create_item so the endpoint returns 422 for missing required fields.

limitations: Only the baseline test suite was executed; no new tests were generated.
